protocol.status: Post-hoc on previously inspected graph and final cases; not independent confirmation
protocol.member_selection: All six existing GCNs, fixed without final-score selection
protocol.averaging: Equal arithmetic mean of six member-temperature-scaled probability vectors
protocol.ensemble_temperature: Positive scalar fit to NLL on temperature role only
protocol.unanimity: All six argmax predictions must agree; no reference labels or known-error IDs
protocol.thresholds: Exact boundaries; >=98% empirical fitting accuracy; at least max(50,ceil(5% eligible class)); maximum coverage
protocol.fit_unanimity_thresholds: Policy-role eligible cases only; independent threshold-only comparator also saved
protocol.resource_scope: CPU inference, prepared graph/input, no GPU profiling of ensemble
